title: Complete a Todo
description: User toggles a todo as done. Walks from the UI through the API to the database.

steps.title: User clicks the toggle
steps.description: The Todo List view captures the click and dispatches a PATCH request.

steps.title: API handles the request
steps.description: PATCH /todos/:id validates the payload and writes through to the store.

steps.title: Store row updated
steps.description: The persisted row flips `done: true` and the response cascades back to the UI.
